_doc: Hand-curated half of the licence inventory (#827). Read by 9_others/src/licence-inventory.py. directories: licence of every top-level directory and of every directory carrying a LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE file. *_licences: licences of dependencies the registries do not publish machine-readably (flake inputs, container images, Terraform providers) - each read from the upstream project's LICENSE file on the date below, never guessed. Where only a LICENSE file was read, a GPL-family licence is recorded as -only: the 'or later' grant lives in source-file headers, which were not checked. Not legal advice.

0____________________.note: Separator directory (sorts the tree); holds no code.

0_git/src.note: Holds the PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 text itself (source of the root LICENSE); the licence text is not third-party code.

I_______________________.note: Separator directory (sorts the tree); holds no code.

a_______________________.note: Separator directory (sorts the tree); holds no code.

z_______________________.note: Separator directory (sorts the tree); holds no code.

github:nixos/nixpkgs.note: The Nix expressions; every package built from it keeps its own licence (meta.license).

raw.githubusercontent.com/diegonmarcos/.note: Own data file fetched as a non-flake input (this repository's config.json).

debian.note: A Debian root filesystem: each package keeps its own licence (mostly GPL/LGPL/BSD/MIT); see /usr/share/doc/*/copyright in the image.
